# Glossary and Additional Resources {#sec-glossary}

| Term | Plain-language meaning |
|---|---|
| Alpha | Prespecified type I error probability for a specified null test |
| Beta | Probability of failing to reject the null under a specified alternative |
| Power | $1-\beta$: probability of rejection at the chosen alternative under model assumptions |
| Confidence interval | An interval procedure with stated long-run coverage under its model |
| Absolute precision | Target half-width of an estimate’s confidence interval, in natural units |
| Effect size | Magnitude of the anticipated difference or association |
| ICC | Within-cluster similarity under an appropriate correlation model |
| Design effect | Ratio of actual-design variance to specified benchmark-design variance |
| FPC | Finite-population correction under eligible sampling assumptions |
| Non-response | Failure to obtain usable study participation or data, depending on definition |
| Non-inferiority | Excluding loss of effect greater than a justified margin |
| Equivalence | Ruling out differences outside justified lower and upper bounds |
| AUC | ROC area, a summary measure of rank discrimination |
